name: pipeline-orchestrator
description: Automated multi-agent pipeline. v5.2.0 (2026-05-08, promoted from v5.2.0-rc.2 with same content; user authorized direct promotion for distribution to all marketplace consumers). v5.2.0-rc.2 (2026-05-08) — Achado #7 protocol adoption expanded to 5 SKILLs (audit/bugfix/feature/spec/pipeline) + brainstorm-controller step agents (step-00-intake, step-01-explore via DISPATCH_REQUEST) + 9 pipeline-controller dispatch sites (Phase 0a/0b/0c, 1.5, 2c/2e, 3a/3b/3c + sentinel) with concrete YAML examples. Closes 3 protocol-coverage lacunas surfaced post-rc.1 adversarial verification. +4 contract regression tests; suite 294 PASS / 10 FAIL (pre-existing Windows CRLF) / 1 SKIPPED. Zero regressions. v5.2.0-rc.1 (2026-05-07) — Achados 1-7 reconciliation + GATE_REQUEST/DISPATCH_REQUEST protocol. Closes 7 contract drift findings from a v5.1.0 dogfood adversarial review. Achados 1-6 are documentation reconciliation (Phase 1.5 plan-mode trigger across 5 surfaces, brainstorm flag propagation, STEP 1.7 classification guard, type=Spec coverage). Achado 7 is architectural: empirical probe confirmed Claude Code harness strips AskUserQuestion/Agent/EnterPlanMode from subagent tool manifests at runtime, regardless of frontmatter; mitigation via emit-and-hoist protocol (3 new block schemas in references/gate-request-protocol.md), adopted in pipeline-controller, brainstorm-controller, executor-controller. Protocol entries live in protocol-events.jsonl (separate from gate-decisions.jsonl) to avoid final-validator's strict 22-gate-registry validation; named gates dual-write for cross-traceability. +13 contract regression tests (suite stays GREEN, zero regressions). 5 follow-ups deferred to v5.2 final: state persistence, lock cleanup, runtime tests, dispatch_id retry, exec-window protocol migration. v5.0.0 — first major release, promoted from v5.0.0-rc.1 with same content. All 7 v5.0 DoD criteria DONE; see CHANGELOG.md [5.0.0] for the promotion summary and [4.17.0] for the technical Wave 8-spec content. v4.17.0 (Wave 8-spec — TRACE.md schema + writer + standalone validator + plan-mode auto-trigger + --no-plan bypass): closes 3 v5.0 DoD criteria in one wave (#2 TRACE.md by default, #3 attachable to PR, #6 plan-mode-enforcer auto-triggers on MEDIA/COMPLEXA). Adds `references/trace-schema/v1.md` (schema_version=1, canonical field order, 1 happy-path + 1 corrupt fixture), `scripts/validate-trace.cjs` (pure-Node validator, exit 0/1 with stderr diff), `tests/integration/trace-writer.test.js` (7 contract tests), `tests/unit/validate-trace.test.js` (5 tests), `tests/unit/plan-mode-trigger.test.js` (5 tests covering MEDIA/COMPLEXA × with/without `--no-plan`). Modifies `agents/core/pipeline-controller.md` Phase 3 closure with new Step 3b-post (TRACE.md emitter wired between final-validator and finishing-branch; opens edit-guard exec-window for cross-tree write to `.pipeline-orchestrator/runs/<run-id>/`); modifies `commands/pipeline.md` Phase 1.5 trigger from `complexity == COMPLEXA` to `complexity ∈ {MEDIA, COMPLEXA} AND --no-plan ausente` plus new `--no-plan` row in modes table; adds asymmetric override semantics (MEDIA + --no-plan = skip+log; COMPLEXA + --no-plan = plan runs anyway, override logged). Corrects `designs/pipeline-orchestrator-v5-consolidated.md` §8 prose to remove ambiguity flagged in `docs/v5-readiness-report.md` §1. Iron Law respected: ZERO changes to gate registry (still 22 in `references/gates.md`), sentinel checkpoints, or agent dispatch namespace; default behavior (no `--no-plan`) preserves v4.16.0 EXACTLY for SIMPLES and COMPLEXA; MEDIA gets plan-architect for the FIRST TIME (additive behavior change, documented in CHANGELOG Behavior Changes section). Suite stays GREEN: 149+17 NEW unit + 7 NEW integration + 5/1 compat + hooks syntax. Wave 8-spec self-hosted dogfood revealed sentinel-hook cwd-discovery brittleness (logged as v5.0-rc.1 follow-up). v4.16.0 (Wave 8-pre / Issue #11 — Real-mode Compat Runner): closes Issue #11 by reimplementing `tests/compat/runner.cjs::executeReal()` from stub to working real-mode CI harness using the `PreToolUse` hook contract that became available in Claude Code v2.1.85+ (`permissionDecision: "allow"` + `updatedInput.answers` to satisfy `AskUserQuestion` in headless mode). Adds `tests/compat/auto-answer-hook.cjs` (generic first-option-default hook with header-keyed overrides via `tests/compat/v4-baseline/answers-overrides.json`), `tests/unit/compat-runner-real.test.js` (8 hook unit tests + 1 conditional real-mode test that skips when claude CLI absent), and splits `.github/workflows/compat-regression.yml` into mock job (always, gate of PR) + real job (opt-in via `vars.CLAUDE_CLI_AVAILABLE=true` + `secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, runs bugfix-fixture smoke on PR or `--all` on `workflow_dispatch`). Updates `designs/slice-0/SPIKE-CI-HARNESS.md` from PARTIAL PASS to PASS. Iron Law respected: ZERO changes to `agents/`, `skills/`, `references/`, `commands/`, `hooks/` (plugin core untouched). Suite stays GREEN: 129 unit + 8 NEW unit + 12 integration + 5 PASS / 1 SKIPPED compat + 8 hooks syntax (exit 0). DoD criterion #5 advances PARTIAL → PARTIAL+. Wave 8 (TRACE.md + plan-mode auto-trigger) remains the next gate to v5.0.0-rc.1. v4.15.0 (Wave 7-spec — v4-to-v5 Migration Doc + v5 Readiness Report): docs-only release that consolidates the v4.0 → v4.14 lineage into `docs/MIGRATION-v4-to-v5.md` (10 sections: lineage table, 13 accumulated breaking changes, FQDN mapping for the v4.9.0 namespace correction, DoD v5.0 status with 3 DONE / 2 PARTIAL / 2 OPEN, compat matrix for FX Studio + Pulsar + custom forks, what v5.0 will/won't change) and adds `docs/v5-readiness-report.md` (1–2-page snapshot at v4.15.0 with the 7-criterion checklist + verification methods + gap analysis + recommended path: Issue #11 → Wave 8 (TRACE.md + plan-mode auto-trigger) → tag v5.0.0-rc.1). Iron Law respected: ZERO changes to agents/, skills/, references/, commands/, hooks/, or tests/. Suite stays GREEN at v4.14.0 levels: 129 unit + 12 integration + 5 PASS / 1 SKIPPED compat + 8 hooks syntax (exit 0). v4.14.0 (Wave 6-spec — Integration Tests + Compat Fixture + Bad-Variant Fixtures): pure additive release that hardens the Wave 1–5 spec lifecycle stack with three layers of net. Adds `tests/integration/spec-workflow-e2e.test.js` (8 new scenarios) covering the spec-format-gate → spec-content-reviewer → spec-post-impl-validator → spec-closer chain, gate hardness/recovery assertions against `references/gates.md` (22-gate registry), `mode_used` mapping in `agents/executor/spec-closer.md` (spec-heavy → full / spec-light → slim / spec-audit-only → audit), and ADVERSARIAL_LOOP_CHECKPOINT counter-reset semantics from v4.13.0 (`shouldEscalate(attempt, batch_changed)` pure function). Adds TEMPLATE compat fixture `tests/compat/v4-baseline/scenarios/spec-fixture/` (input.md + expected.yaml; no mock-output.json) staking out the spec-heavy observable contract for a future dogfooding session — runner.cjs auto-discovers and SKIPs it via the case-insensitive TEMPLATE check. Adds three bad-variant spec fixtures under `tests/fixtures/specs/`: `auth-flow-bad-yaml/` (intentionally unparseable spec.json → SPEC_FORMAT_GATE_FAIL HARD via critical-artifact rule), `auth-flow-no-traceability/` (design.md stripped of Traces-to + Glossary + responsibilities + data model + contracts → ≥8 of 25 checks fail → score ≤17 → NO-GO), `auth-flow-missing-artifact/` (tasks.md absent → SPEC_ARTIFACT_MISSING MANDATORY before format scoring runs). One surgical edit in `tests/unit/compat-baselines.test.js` relaxes a hard-coded SKIPPED regex (0 → 0 or 1) to accommodate the new TEMPLATE fixture, with comment pointing to the future tighten-back trigger. Iron Law respected: ZERO changes to agents/, skills/, references/, commands/, hooks/. Suite: 129 unit + 12 integration (was 4) + 5 PASS / 1 SKIPPED compat, all exit 0. v4.13.0 (Gates Invariants & Mode Persistence — Wave 5-spec): adds 6 spec gates to references/gates.md registry (SSOT sync with pipeline-controller.md Inline Invariants, closing ARCH-1 gap from v4.11.0 adversarial review); extends commands/pipeline.md Inline Invariants from 15 to 21 gate names; adds Spec row to complexity-matrix.md Pipeline Routing Matrix; introduces mode_used field (slim|full|audit) to spec-context-schema.md as spec.json field; wires mode_used write step into spec-closer.md based on pipeline_variant. +16 unit tests (gates registry parsing, escalation rule, variant→mode mapping, regression baseline). v4.12.0 (Wave 4-spec — /spec entry-point + 3 pipeline composition refs): adds the thin manual-only `skills/spec/SKILL.md` entry-point (mirrors skills/bugfix, skills/audit, skills/feature pattern), pre-classifying `task_type=Spec` to skip the type-detection round in task-orchestrator. Variant flags `--light` / `--heavy` / `--audit-only` route directly to skills/spec-light, spec-heavy, or spec-audit-only with their prescriptive 6/9/5-step procedures (Wave 2). Without a flag, dispatches to pipeline-controller, which uses the Wave 3-spec 4-signal classifier to select the right variant. Three new pipeline composition reflexes (`references/pipelines/spec-light.md`, `spec-heavy.md`, `spec-audit-only.md`) document team composition + step-by-step flow with 1:1 fidelity to their SKILL.md sequence_lock — enforced by a new cross-ref test (`tests/unit/spec-entry-point-and-pipelines.test.js`, +8 tests, suite 103→111). Backward compat preserved: `/pipeline-orchestrator:pipeline` full classifier path is unchanged; existing entry-points (bugfix/audit/feature) untouched. Zero changes to agents/, no changes to skills/spec-light, skills/spec-heavy, skills/spec-audit-only, references/gates.md, or commands/pipeline.md (purely additive). v4.11.0 (Wave 3-spec — Spec Classifier Routing): wires type=Spec first-class classification into task-orchestrator (4-signal detection: explicit path / --type=spec flag / prose regex / glob fallback), routes spec-light/spec-heavy/spec-audit-only via pipeline-controller skill dispatch (mirrors bugfix pattern), adds 5 spec sentinel checkpoints (guarded on pipeline_variant.startsWith("spec-")), AC-seeded ATDD in quality-gate-router (1 scenario per AC, EARS preserved + bullet normalized), GO/CONDITIONAL/NO-GO vs PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED vocabulary doc in audit-trail.md. Backward compat preserved (non-spec pipelines route exactly as v4.10.0); zero changes to Wave 1 spec lifecycle agents or Wave 2 spec skill trees. v4.10.0 (Wave 3 — Compat Baselines): graduates all 5 compat fixtures (audit/bugfix/feature/hotfix/ux) from TEMPLATE → REAL baselines captured 2026-05-05 against pipeline v4.10.0. Each fixture now ships paired `expected.yaml` + `mock-output.json` with the 5 observable contract fields (classification, gates_triggered, agents_invoked, artifacts_produced, verdict). Real-mode wiring of the runner remains a Slice 4-extended item: `executeReal` is still a stub due to upstream `--ci-auto-confirm` gap in Claude Code (documented in `designs/slice-0/SPIKE-CI-HARNESS.md`). v4.9.x: spec workflow polish + CI debt. v4.9.0 (Spec Workflow Import — Wave 2): imports 3 prescriptive skill trees. v4.8.0 (Hook Enforcement). v4.7.0 (Slice 3b polish). v4.6.x (Slice 3b feature workflow). v4.5.0 (Slice 3a audit). v4.4.x (Slice 1.5 bugfix import). v4.3.x (skill migration). v4.2.x (SEC patches + thin entry-points). v4 base: orchestration in isolated controller agent.
